operation_details.item: The user completed the Acme Corp renewal negotiation.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Good morning. With the end of Q2 approaching, how are the Acme Corp renewal discussions going?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Good morning. I completed the Acme Corp renewal negotiation.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Nice work. That should help with our quarterly numbers. What's the immediate next step?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: The renewal contract is sent for signature.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Good. While that's in motion, are there any upsell opportunities you've identified with Acme?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: An expansion add-on has been proposed.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Sounds promising. Will you be managing the implementation, or is customer success getting involved?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: The handoff to customer success is scheduled.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Great. That ensures a smooth transition. Do you anticipate any pushback on the expansion add-on before it's accepted?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Not at this point. The conversations have been very collaborative.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Excellent. Keep me posted if anything changes. Is there anything else you need from me to close out this renewal?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: No, I think we're all set. I'll update the forecast accordingly.
